title: Legendary Class
overview: Grid hopes to strike it rich in the VR game Satisfy. While taking on an S-Ranked quest, he discovers Pagma’s Tome.

title: First Step Towards Being a Blacksmith
overview: Grid has made a fresh start. With nowhere else to turn, he begins learning the fundamentals of blacksmithing.

title: Second Class
overview: The Mero Company sends Huroi, an Orator, to the village. There, he forcibly triggers a hidden quest...!?

title: Item Crafting Face-Off
overview: Grid faces Euphemina in a blacksmithing contest. The contest turns into an S-Ranked quest to rescue Huroi.

title: Family's Trust
overview: Grid continues his blacksmithing. He puts up an epic armor for auction, and gets a request for more.
